canonical_project: Microsoft Azure South Africa West (Cape Town) Region

location.subnational: Western Cape - City of Cape Town

notes: Microsoft made Azure South Africa West (Cape Town) and South Africa North (Johannesburg) generally available on 6 March 2019, the first major hyperscaler datacenters in Africa. Azure official regional list (azure.microsoft.com/explore/global-infrastructure) confirms both regions. Capacity in MW not publicly disclosed.
